meta.notes: Playtest 4, P4-19 (sheet I2): the interstate's big hazard, a tractor and a long box trailer, no brand and no words on it. It runs only where a road is tagged `interstate` (the region's traffic area), a touch quicker than the log truck and as long: 16 m is the longest vehicle the region already has, because the rival AI sizes every vehicle by the largest type of the race (`vehicleSize`, src/sim/ai/sense.ts), so a longer type would change how every rival rides round every car on every Pacific Northwest road. Its model is the shared semi (16.5 m, drawn at 16 m).
